name: O3b mPower 11-13
slot_a_text: B1080 on its 29th flight. Perfect 28 for 28 on landings. Last flew Starlink Group 10-45 about 2 months ago. Targeting ASOG, 660 km downrange.
slot_b_text: SpaceX's 109th launch of the year, 728th all time. 47th from SLC-40 this year, 19 days since the last one. The 216th orbital launch attempt worldwide this year. Falcon 9 is on a 332 flight success streak.
description: 3 high-throughput communications satellites in Medium Earth Orbit (MEO) built by Boeing and operated by SES.
rocket_fact: The 'Octaweb' engine arrangement is designed to protect surrounding engines if one Merlin engine explodes.
